en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a snowy mountain landscape. In the foreground is a curved, elevated bobsleigh track fenced with wooden railings. In the middle distance stands a large alpine-style lodge or hut on a slope, surrounded by forest. Rolling, tree-covered mountains extend into the background. The caption in German is printed in the lower left margin.
